spec_source: BG-F-CLM-LORA-4-RE-MEASURE follow-up to F-CLM-LORA-4-FIXTURE; alternate-locus axis-cond preservation measurement.
substrate: ubu1 (RTX 5070 sm_120) cuda fp32; torch=2.11.0+cu128; venv /home/aiden/venv_orchestrator

method.design: two alternate loci; locus_a = ln_ffn (per-layer pre-FFN LayerNorm) output per-axis cosine LoRA-vs-base; locus_b = generation-level axis-distinct response BLEU-1 cross-axis preservation

locus_0_carry.note: Predecessor base off-diag mean = 0.996 means ln_f-mean locus is structurally near-degenerate; this FAIL is metric-locus mismatch per honest_c3 #4/#8/#9, not architectural axis-cond loss.

verdict_thresholds.RE_VERDICT: PASS if >=2/3 locus PASS, PARTIAL if 1/3, FAIL if 0/3

honest_c3: C1: Locus A pivoted from 'cross_attn output' (BG spec) to 'ln_ffn per-layer output'. Reason: canonical inference uses consciousness_states=None, which the decoder block guards via `if consciousness_states is not None: x = x + cross_attn(ln_cross(x), ...)`. With None (the canonical/training/eval path; predecessor F4 verified n_cross_attn_lora=0 + this conditional bypass), neither cross_attn nor ln_cross fires; their forward_hooks never trigger. ln_ffn (LayerNorm immediately before SwiGLU FFN) is the most downstream per-layer LayerNorm that ALWAYS fires and captures the integrated residual stream after self-attn / CA-mix / META-CA / PureFieldFFN tension / inter-layer whisper / (no-op when None) cross_attn. Per-layer ln_ffn (16 layers) is far more granular than the single decoder.ln_f terminus the predecessor used (which is structurally near-degenerate at base off-diag mean = 0.996). The cross_attn weights themselves are LoRA-untouched (n_cross_attn_lora=0); the meaningful question is whether q/k/v/o LoRA on self-attn shifted the per-layer residual flow — ln_ffn-per-layer answers this.

C2: generation-level eval is greedy decoding (deterministic argmax), may miss diverse axis-distinct outputs that live in tail-of-distribution. Sampling (top_p=0.9 temperature=0.8) would expand the diff signal but introduce variance; we chose greedy for reproducibility per raw#9. Real axis-cond influence on sampling tail is unmeasured here.

C3: axis-prefix conditioning (AXIS_PREFIXES dict) is anima-internal heuristic — the prefixes [일상 톤]/[감정에 공감하며]/etc are SSOT-consistent with the predecessor's prompt set but their EFFICACY at inducing axis-cond gate activation in the model is itself the question; we assume the model trained with these prefixes will respond to them, but the LoRA SFT corpus may have used DIFFERENT prefix wording. honest about prefix-corpus alignment uncertainty.

C4: 60-prompt sample size for Locus B is limited; per-axis preservation = mean over 12 bodies, std not reported. With only 12 paired observations per axis, sampling noise on BLEU-1 cross-axis overlap can be ~0.05 magnitude; verdict bands chosen accordingly.

C5: LoRA cross_attn EXCLUDED at training time (n_cross_attn_lora=0 asserted). At Locus A we EXPECT high preservation (near 1.0) because the cross_attn weights are LITERALLY UNCHANGED by LoRA — the residual variance comes from LoRA q/k/v/o on self-attn shifting upstream representations that feed cross_attn as KV. Locus A near-1.0 PASS is partly STRUCTURAL-BY-CONSTRUCTION; this is a feature (the architectural axis path is preserved) not a bug. Locus B (generation-level) is the more independent test.

C6: BLEU-1 over SentencePiece subword token-ids is a coarse lexical similarity proxy; doesn't capture semantic axis distinction (e.g. tone shift without lexical overlap change). A more rigorous Locus B would use sentence-embedding cosine on the GENERATED text, but that requires loading an additional encoder ($0 ubu1 budget compatible but +1 dependency). BLEU-1 chosen for self-contained eval; honest about the lexical-only limitation.

C7: per_axis_preservation = 1 - |base_other_overlap - lora_other_overlap| measures whether LoRA preserved the BASE's pattern of how distinct one axis is from others, not absolute axis distinctness. If base produces nearly-identical generations across axes (cross_axis_bleu1 high) AND LoRA also produces nearly-identical generations, preservation will score HIGH even though neither model is actually axis-conditioning. Read alongside base_cross_axis_bleu1_mean and lora_cross_axis_bleu1_mean — large value (>0.5) at base means base is itself axis-blind (fails axis-cond at generation). Lower base value = more meaningful preservation signal.
